title: 第7章 冤家路窄第8章 打碎狗牙
content_zh:
第7章冤家路窄
在这林府之中，实力便是决定一切地位的前提，没有实力，曾经楚风眠就算是有着林府外府大管家的身份，但是就连任何一位普通的林府弟子都对楚风眠从不在意。
这一次展现出自己实力的时候，才是真正拥有身份，地位。
而这一次，再也没有任何一位林府弟子，敢来在阻挡楚风眠，都主动让开一条路，让楚风眠走进其中。
“这个月的俸禄，拿来吧。”
灵药殿发放俸禄的人，也只是一位平常的林府外府弟子。
看到楚风眠走进来，他的脸色也是变得极为慌张，听到楚风眠的询问，支支吾吾的半天，才开口道。
“楚大管家，您这个月的俸禄已经被人代领走了。”
“代领？”
楚风眠的眼神之中露出几分寒意。
在这林府之中，可还从未有着代领俸禄这一说，之前只是因为楚风眠实力不济，他的俸禄才会被人领走。
而这一次，竟然还敢有人来领的俸禄。
“大管家恕罪，是小的错……”
那外府弟子急忙的低头认罪道。
本来他也没有把楚风眠当做是什么外府大管家，刚刚有人来领楚风眠的俸禄，他自然便是将俸禄给了那些人，毕竟楚风眠从来没有追究过的。
可是这一次，楚风眠竟然是亲自来了。
刚刚楚风眠教训那林苟的时候，这外府弟子也是看在眼中，他也明白，现在的楚风眠早已经不是曾经的楚风眠了。
他可不想落到那林苟的下场，被踩断四肢，只能是乖乖认罪。
“说吧，是谁领走了。”
楚风眠看了一眼那外府弟子，冷声开口道。

“是林莫，林叶二人。”
外府弟子恭敬的回答道。
“果然。”
听到这两个名字，楚风眠眼神之中露出几分杀意。
曾经的那位楚风眠，便是就被这两人活活打死的，看来这一次，楚风眠也该是去找个公道了。
“那林苟的俸禄，拿来吧。”
楚风眠看了一眼那外府弟子，冷声说道。
“这……”
听到楚风眠的话，那外府弟子有些为难说道，可是当看到楚风眠冰冷的眼神之后，他也将毫不犹豫的拿出了一瓶丹药来递给了楚风眠。
林苟现在已经是一个废人了，就算是想要报复，也需要几个月的时间，可现在的楚风眠，若是得罪了，只怕是会沦为跟林苟一样的下场。
“这是林苟这个月的俸禄。”
“以后每个月的俸禄，都主动送到我这里去，要是少了半点，你也跟那林苟一样下场。”
楚风眠看了一眼那外府弟子，言语冰冷道。
“是，是。”
那外府弟子急忙点了点头，楚风眠接过玉瓶，便是大步离开了灵药殿。
一直等到楚风眠离开，那外府弟子才终于松了口气。
“这楚风眠，怎么会如此实力，不行，要向副管家大人禀告一声去了。”
那外府弟子自言自语几声，便是换了一个人来发放俸禄，他自己一个人便是离开了。
林府外府之中，一处宽阔的院落之中，两名壮汉正坐在石桌前，在他们的面前摆放有着数个玉瓶。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Enemies meet on a narrow road
In the Lin Mansion, strength is the prerequisite for determining all status. Without strength, Chu Fengmian once had the status of the Lin Mansion's chief steward, but even any ordinary Lin Mansion disciple would never care about Chu Fengmian.
When you show your strength this time, you truly have your identity and status.
But this time, no Lin Mansion disciple dared to block Chu Fengmian, and they all took the initiative to make way for Chu Fengmian to walk in.
"Bring me this month's salary."
The person who received the salary from the Spiritual Medicine Hall was just an ordinary disciple from outside the Lin Mansion.
When he saw Chu Fengmian walking in, his expression became extremely flustered. When he heard Chu Fengmian's inquiry, he hesitated for a long time before speaking.
"Butler Chu, your salary for this month has been taken away by someone else."
"Collect it on your behalf?"
There was a hint of chill in Chu Fengmian's eyes.
In the Lin Mansion, there has never been such a thing as receiving salary on behalf of others. Previously, Chu Fengmian's salary was only taken away because of his lack of strength.
But this time, someone actually dared to come and receive the salary.
"I'm sorry, butler, it's a small mistake..."
The foreign disciple hurriedly lowered his head and confessed.
Originally, he did not regard Chu Fengmian as some kind of great housekeeper of the foreign government. Someone just came to collect Chu Fengmian's salary, so he naturally gave it to those people. After all, Chu Fengmian had never pursued any investigation.
But this time, Chu Fengmian came in person.
When Chu Fengmian taught Lin Gou a lesson just now, the disciple from the outside world also saw it, and he also understood that the Chu Fengmian now is no longer the Chu Fengmian he once was.
He didn't want to end up like Lin Gou, whose limbs would be trampled off, so he could only admit his guilt.
"Tell me, who took it away."
Chu Fengmian glanced at the foreign disciple and said coldly.
"It's Lin Mo and Lin Ye."
The outer disciple replied respectfully.
"Sure enough."
Hearing these two names, Chu Fengmian's eyes showed a bit of murderous intent.
The former Chu Fengmian was beaten to death by these two people. It seems that this time, Chu Fengmian should seek justice.
"Then bring Lin Gou's salary."
Chu Fengmian glanced at the foreign disciple and said coldly.
"This..."
Hearing Chu Fengmian's words, the outer disciple was a little embarrassed, but when he saw Chu Fengmian's cold eyes, he took out a bottle of pills and handed it to Chu Fengmian without hesitation.
Lin Gou is now a useless person. Even if he wants revenge, it will take several months. But if Chu Fengmian is offended now, he will probably end up like Lin Gou.
"This is Lin Gou's salary for this month."
"From now on, you will take the initiative to send your monthly salary to me. If it is less than even a little bit, you will end up like that Lin Gou."
Chu Fengmian glanced at the foreign disciple and said coldly.
"Yes, yes."
The outer disciple nodded hurriedly, Chu Fengmian took the jade bottle and strode out of the Spiritual Medicine Hall.
It wasn't until Chu Fengmian left that the outer disciple finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"How can this Chu Fengmian be so powerful? If it doesn't work, I have to report it to the deputy housekeeper."
The foreign disciple muttered to himself, and then someone else came to distribute the salary, and he left alone.
In the outer courtyard of Lin Mansion, in a wide courtyard, two strong men were sitting in front of a stone table, with several jade bottles placed in front of them.
